title: Restriction (banlist)
description: A DATED, immutable banlist/restriction document. New ban wave = new document; formats point at the active one. Never edit a published restriction — issue the next one (stewardship communities' errata/banlist history is first-class, not a flag on cards). Files: restrictions/*.yaml.

banned.description: Card IDs (rules identity — a ban hits every printing).

restricted.description: Card IDs limited to 1 copy (or game-defined meaning).

notes.description: Designer reasoning — communities deserve the why.
